name: io.github.expertvagabond/coldstar-agent-signer
title: Coldstar Agent Signer
description: Policy-gated Solana signing for AI agents. In-policy transactions auto-sign on a cold-rooted session key, out-of-policy transactions escalate to air-gapped human approval, and disallowed or injected transactions are rejected without ever producing a signature.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: Path to the policy file, or to a root-signed policy envelope. The envelope is the intended form: it is what makes the limits unforgeable by the agent.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_SESSION_KEYFILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to the session keypair file. This key spends only within the policy and is never the root key.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_SESSION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The session secret key inline, as an alternative to COLDSTAR_SESSION_KEYFILE. Prefer the keyfile.

environmentVariables.name: RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana RPC endpoint. Defaults to devnet; this package is beta and devnet is the supported target.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_ROOT_PUBKEY
environmentVariables.description: Pins the root public key that must have signed the policy envelope. Without it the signer warns, because an unpinned root means any root will do.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_REQUIRE_ENVELOPE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse a bare policy file and accept only a root-signed envelope.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_CHECK_REVOCATION
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to check the on-chain revocation marker before every decision. Fail-closed: a revoked grant rejects, an unreachable chain escalates.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Path to the spend ledger that carries the daily cap across restarts.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_CHAIN_LEDGER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to read the day's real spend back from the chain, so deleting the local ledger cannot reset the daily cap.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_SIMULATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to simulate opaque transactions before deciding, or 'always' to simulate every transaction. The wallet then takes the larger of the static and simulated debit.

environmentVariables.name: COLDSTAR_ALLOW_MESSAGE_SIGNING
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to allow arbitrary message signing. Off by default, because a signed message is a capability the policy cannot inspect.
